notes.title: Only 3 months...
notes.content:
Hi, guys.
I will give the news of the game...

[h2] -Modes:[/h2]
Kid, Easy, and Normal mode are 100% ready. Only Hard is missing and I'm still testing the new mechanics.

[h2] -Visual:[/h2]
I created the visuals with culture from Mato Grosso, the player can choose any visual before starting the game.
Image:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075496/ee7f89aa353359b45036e1418110bc33b7828be1.png[/img]

[h2] -Incredible news:[/h2]
I contacted an artist called "Victor Hugo Dos Santos", he let me use his art as a partnership. In the game, two of his arts will appear in the "Extra".
Victor Hugo dos Santos is a great painting artist with the style of Mato Grosso, his arts are incredible. And if you want to know more about this artist, he has an instagram.
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/victor.h.santos.79/]>>LINK<<[/url]

[h2] -Release Date?[/h2]
It will be in the month of February 2023. I'll put how many days are left until the Launch day.
